parameters.query:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE name='TB_N8N_ERROR_LOG' and xtype='U')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE TB_N8N_ERROR_LOG (
        ID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        WORKFLOW_NAME NVARCHAR(255),
        WORKFLOW_ID NVARCHAR(50),
        EXECUTION_ID NVARCHAR(50),
        NODE_NAME NVARCHAR(255),
        ERROR_MESSAGE NVARCHAR(MAX),
        DIAGNOSIS NVARCHAR(MAX),
        CAUSE NVARCHAR(MAX),
        RESOLUTION NVARCHAR(MAX),
        CREATED_AT DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
    );
END

INSERT INTO TB_N8N_ERROR_LOG (
    WORKFLOW_NAME, WORKFLOW_ID, EXECUTION_ID, NODE_NAME, 
    ERROR_MESSAGE, DIAGNOSIS, CAUSE, RESOLUTION
) VALUES (
    '{{ ($('Extrai Erros').item.json.workflowName || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ ($('Extrai Erros').item.json.workflowId || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ ($('Extrai Erros').item.json.executionId || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ ($('Extrai Erros').item.json.nodeName || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ ($('Extrai Erros').item.json.errorMessage || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ ($json.output.diagnostico || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ ($json.output.causa || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ ($json.output.solucao || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
);
